baselineRule: The first reviewed exact-candidate Windows receipt establishes the baseline only after one complete, unmeasured prepared-profile lifecycle and exactly five fully closed process-cold launches. The metric comes only from the qualification-only main-process monotonic probe, from process entry through both windows being shown; Playwright readiness time is recorded separately but never scored. Every preparation and measured launch must prove two visible sandboxed windows and zero-survivor teardown; no sample may be retried or discarded. The median of all five probe readings is the budget metric. Missing, unverified, non-exact, or nonconforming measurements fail closed.
